name: [UPD 🐵] Grow Eggs🥚
desc:
🥚 Welcome to Grow An Egg!

💡 [How To Hatch] 
• Equip the egg seed you want to plant!
• Click on your soil to plant it!
• Watch it grow through multiple stages!
• Once it's fully grown, hatch it and discover your new pet!

⭐ Your eggs keep growing even when you're offline — so come back to surprises!
Fan remake of popular game "Grow a Garden🍅"❤️
